diff_evidence.base_excerpt: Protocol v1. HTTP 200 on an order read means the request succeeded, not that the order completed. Callback is emitted only after COMPLETED. A PROCESSING order does not prove a callback failure. Query current order state before drawing a root cause. Use the same bound order version when correlating its callback event.
diff_evidence.target_excerpt: Protocol v2. HTTP 200 confirms only that the bound order read succeeded. Callback creation follows the terminal COMPLETED transition, but event publication can be asynchronous. Correlate the event's order version to the current bound order and inspect a delivery attempt before attributing a missing callback to transport failure. Do not treat PROCESSING as a callback incident.
